Subject: Post-call recap + MAP items: security review & SOC 2 deliverables

Thanks again for the call this morning — great to meet you both. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have everything in the Mutual Action Plan (MAP):

1) Goal/Target close: Mutual agreement on SOC 2 readiness items to unblock procurement and legal sign-off. Target commercial close: 2026-07-14 (tentative) — please flag if that doesn't work.

2) Security milestone (primary MAP deliverable) — owner: FinAssure & Redwood collaboration
  - Security questionnaire (you): FinAssure to return completed questionnaire (we provided v0.3) — due: 2026-05-24
  - Evidence roster / artifacts (joint): FinAssure provides pointer to artifacts (S3/GDrive links or zipped evidence). Redwood to annotate mapping to SOC 2 controls — due: 2026-06-07
  - SOC 2 package delivery (Redwood pre-pack + custom notes): Redwood to deliver packaged evidence and control narrative for customer review — due: 2026-06-14
  - Final security acceptance checkpoint (call + signoff): target week of 2026-06-21

3) Dependencies & open items:
  - Legal review / contract redline (Procurement) — early July window; procurement (Jake) to advise exact SLA
  - SSO / SAML integration timeline (engineering) — may push acceptance date if required
  - Any third-party vendor attestations (you): let us know if you need vendor-specific evidence formatting

4) Next steps (action owners):
  - Emily/Jake: confirm questionnaire turnaround (due 5/24) and the primary evidence storage location (S3 link or shared Drive)
  - Marissa: will own the Redwood evidence mapping and delivery cadence
  - Rishi: will own the security contact for technical evidence (logs, retention, config snapshots)

Attached: draft MAP spreadsheet (FinAssure_MAP_DRAFT_20260517.xlsx), current answers doc (Security_Questionnaire_Answers_v0.3.docx) and an evidence roster template (SOC2_Evidence_Roster.csv). I uploaded the draft MAP to the shared folder — link below.

Can you confirm the 5/24 questionnaire turnaround and whether the 6/14 SOC 2 package delivery window looks acceptable? If you'd prefer a different milestone cadence we can adjust.

Best,

Subject: Re: Post-call recap + MAP items: security review & SOC 2 deliverables

Thanks, Soojin — helpful recap. Two quick clarifications: 

1) SOC 2 type: We are expecting a Type II package (covering the last 12 months). Does your pre-pack include Type II artifacts and control narratives?
2) Evidence format: Procurement prefers direct links to evidence in our secure S3 bucket rather than zipped attachments. We also need a CSV roster mapping artifact -> control ID (your template looks good).

We can commit to completing the questionnaire by 2026-05-24. For the evidence location: we'll create an S3 read-only prefix and share access by EOD 2026-05-20.

One more ask from procurement (cc'ing Jake on their public inbox) — are there any minimum retention or log export samples we should expect to provide for review? Jake, if you have procurement SLAs, can you flag any timing constraints?

Thanks,
Emily

Appreciate the quick turnaround, Emily. Short answers: yes — our package is organized for Type II reviews (we include control narratives, user access reviews, and representative logs). We will annotate which artifacts are Type II evidence vs. operational notes.

Per your note about S3, that's perfect — please share the prefix once it's ready (we prefer presigned read-only links per artifact).

Attached is the MAP draft (FinAssure_MAP_DRAFT_20260517.xlsx). Key milestone table pulled into the body below for visibility: 

MILESTONE | OWNER | WHAT | DUE
--- | --- | --- | ---
Questionnaire return | FinAssure (Emily) | Completed questionnaire v0.3 | 2026-05-24
Evidence pointer & initial roster | FinAssure (Jake) | S3 prefix + CSV roster | 2026-05-20 (S3 share) / roster by 2026-05-24
Redwood annotation & gap notes | Marissa (Redwood) | Map artifacts to SOC 2 controls, call out missing items | 2026-06-07
SOC 2 package delivery (draft) | Marissa / Soojin | Packaged evidence + narratives for FinAssure review | 2026-06-14
Security acceptance checkpoint | Emily / Rishi | Review call + sign-off or open items list | week of 2026-06-21
Final contract redline complete | FinAssure / Redwood legal | Signed commercial agreement | 2026-07-14

Risks that may shift dates: longer legal turnaround, need for live SSO test, or requests for full raw log exports (we can provide samples but can be time-consuming).

Marissa / Rishi — can you confirm owners below and note any additional internal dependencies? I will push the draft MAP into HubSpot and share the Drive link when the S3 prefix is live.

Thanks — Soojin
